cds.title: Morehead State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; file is named cds-2025-2026 and reports Fall 2025 data, though its page headers still read 2024-2025)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 first-time first-year class (CDS C1 residency breakdown: 1,426 international applicants, 730 admitted, 44 enrolled; 72 applicants of unknown residency). International admit rate (about half) is far lower than the overall rate. Undergraduate enrollment 7,941 and nonresident 98 are the B2 total-undergraduate figures, which include many non-degree dual-credit students (degree-seeking undergraduates: 4,541). GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11 (whole percents, summing to 99). SAT percentiles rest on only 45 students (4%); ACT was submitted by 1,041 (82%). CDS C7 factor checkboxes are not legible in the PDF text, so factors are omitted. Student-to-faculty ratio 16:1 is from CDS section I.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A column marks are not legible; the admission requirements page says the ACT/SAT are generally not required for undergraduate admission but are needed for scholarships, placement or some programs.

cost.notes: The CDS section G dollar figures are blank in the PDF text; costs come from the university tuition pages (see cycle file).
